output.brief: Cancelling RotaWeave is unlikely to fix this. The drop is concentrated at Dock Street and Westgate, where the app is live and the coordinator post was cut on 1 May. Millbrook has the app but kept its coordinator, and it is stable. Quarry Lane lost its coordinator but has no app and only slipped slightly. So neither change alone explains the fall. Together they do. The basic app tier has no recurring bookings, and coordinators used to book regulars into their usual slots. Since 1 May that has almost stopped (74 a week fell to 3). Of the April regulars at those two sites, 129 lost their usual slot at least twice, and 88% of them are now inactive. Background checks do not explain it: 121 of the 123 who lapsed had a current check. Commonplate shows little sign of a role: only 2 of 61 callbacks mention another group. I'm fairly confident, but the picture rests on one manager's compiled records plus site counts. Next steps: put someone on the unused admin seat to book regulars into their usual slots before each Thursday release at Dock Street and Westgate, phone lapsed regulars to offer slots back, and review after 60 days. Keep the background checks, because the county contract and insurer require them. Don't purge inactive names from the roster. Take this to the board instead of the cancellation.
